## FlowBox v1.0.3 — 菜单栏收纳去重与准确命名 / 录屏可靠性修复

在 v1.0.2 基础上修复两类问题：

- **菜单栏收纳：不再重复列出可见应用**。此前下拉菜单会把顶栏上已经可见的状态项**再列一遍**（最典型的就是「顶栏一个 QQ、下拉又一个 QQ」）。根因是可见性判据不可靠（`kCGWindowIsOnscreen` 对被刘海挤掉的项也报可见），以及外接显示器会给同一批状态项**再渲染一份独立窗口**。现在可见性改为按 X 坐标落在刘海两侧可用区内判定，并按坐标归属屏幕剔除镜像副本 —— 下拉只列**真正被隐藏**的项。
- **下拉条目能正确显示应用名**。匿名 `Item-0` 窗口通过**跨屏同宽度副本**对上身份（同一项在另一块屏上常带 bundle id；宽度是硬约束，左右顺序会翻转），因此显示的是 **QQ** 而不是「菜单栏图标 7789」这类窗口号。外部退出应用留下的**残留位置键**不再参与配对（数量不等即放弃），避免标题张冠李戴。
- **不再出现 `?` 占位行**。缩略图抓取失败且身份未定时，标题退化为**包名**或「菜单栏图标 <窗口号>」，图标退化为透明图 —— 任何条目都有可读文字，且点击照常生效。
- **修复录屏中途失败 / 崩溃**。writer 现在**先进入 writing 状态再开始采集**（此前首个样本可能早于 `startWriting` 到达，会让 `startSession(atSourceTime:)` 抛异常并崩溃）；麦克风输出**显式声明 16-bit LPCM**（不声明时 macOS 26 会协商出「1 声道、0 Hz」的无效格式，导致 `AVAssetWriter` 报 -16122 直接失败）；采集回调统一走**一条串行队列**保证样本按 PTS 递增写入；跳过 SCK 的无图像内容帧；写入失败**立即收尾**而不是继续堆积无效样本。错误日志展开完整 `NSError` 链，不再是「这项操作无法完成」。

Two kinds of fixes since v1.0.2:

- **Menu bar hider: visible apps are no longer listed twice.** The dropdown used to repeat status items that were already visible in the menu bar (typically "one QQ up top, another QQ in the dropdown"). Visibility was judged with `kCGWindowIsOnscreen`, which also reports ON for items pushed out by the notch, and an external display makes macOS render a **second, independent window** for the same set of status items. Visibility is now decided by X position against the notch-free areas, and mirrored per-display windows are dropped — the dropdown lists **only what is really hidden**.
- **Dropdown rows show the right app name.** Anonymous `Item-0` windows are matched against their **cross-screen clone of equal width** (the same item usually carries a bundle id on the other display; width is the hard constraint, left-to-right order can flip), so a row reads **QQ** instead of "菜单栏图标 7789". Stale preferred-position keys left behind by quit apps no longer take part in pairing, so titles can't be shifted onto the wrong app.
- **No more bare `?` rows.** When the thumbnail fails and the identity is unknown, the title falls back to the **package name** or "菜单栏图标 <windowNumber>" and the icon to a transparent image — every row stays readable and clickable.
- **Fix: recording aborts and crashes.** The writer now **enters the writing state before capture starts** (a first sample arriving earlier made `startSession(atSourceTime:)` throw and crash the process); the microphone output **declares 16-bit LPCM explicitly** (otherwise macOS 26 negotiates an invalid "1 ch, 0 Hz" format and `AVAssetWriter` fails with -16122); all capture callbacks share **one serial queue** so samples are written in increasing PTS order; non-image SCK frames are skipped; a failed write **finishes immediately** instead of piling up invalid samples. Logs now expand the full `NSError` chain.

### 安装 / Install

1. 下载下方 FlowBox.dmg，把 FlowBox.app 拖进 Applications。
2. 首次打开请在"应用程序"里右键点击 FlowBox →"打开"（自签名包，直接双击会报无法验证开发者，只需做一次）。
3. 点菜单栏图标 →「启用扩展」，在系统设置中打开 FlowBox 的 Finder 扩展开关；按需授予辅助功能、屏幕录制、摄像头、麦克风权限。
